## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 correctly proves the rank-plus-Smith criterion, including the stated boundary cases.
- claim-3 is internally inconsistent: its Findings assert \(T_d=\varnothing\) for \(d>D=rq\), while its Strategy correctly notes that the displayed definition can make \(T_d\) nonempty there.
- claim-3 leaves \(N_d\) as an arbitrary “prescribed target rank.” This does not identify \(N\) degreewise for the stated \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\) application, as explicitly required.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Give one consistent degreewise presentation: define \(R_d\) only for \(d_0\le d\le D\) (and use \(0\to0\) outside that range), and explicitly define the intended \(N_d\)—including all boundary cases and \(N=\sum_dN_d\)—before applying the proved rank-plus-Smith criterion.
